accepted_problem: Can existing projector parameters functionally replace additional recovery modules after a fixed structural reduction?
required_distinctions: text-only reduction leaves projected vision features unchanged; vision feature L2 is not an effective recovery target
answer loss through a frozen LLM still needs backward operations to train its input projector
vision-only feature matching avoids LLM backward but does not establish answer quality
dense plus same-budget recovery control is needed to separate general extra training benefit
success does not prove exclusive alignment damage; failure does not prove irreversible capacity loss
paper LLM pruning fraction is not our whole-package byte reduction
do_not_launch_if: current two CPU cases are incomplete
selection uses the five seen TRAIN probes or DEV seen by formal teacher
full backward/teacher/activation cost is not bounded
same-budget dense recovery control is unaffordable
paper 5 percent is treated as evidence that 1313 examples suffice
